user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account using my email and password so that I can access my personal dashboard. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The login form contains an input field with id 'email' and placeholder 'Your email'. 2. The login form contains an input field with id 'password' and placeholder 'Your password'. 3. The login button is present with data-test 'login-submit' and value 'Login'. 4. Upon successful login, the URL should change from 'https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login' to the user's dashboard URL. 5. If the login form is submitted empty, the URL should remain 'https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login'.
